knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
install.packages("ggrain")
install.packages("ggplot2")
```


## Hypothesis

H1: Points allocated to a partner's physical attractiveness differ by sex at birth.

H2: Confidence in finding a new partner is associated with relationship commitment.

```{r load package}

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrain)

```

## Load the processed data

```{r loadData}
#load processed data
h1data <-read.csv("data/processed_data/221A_h1.csv")
h2data <- read.csv("data/processed_data/221A_h2.csv")

#reorganize categorical variable
h1data$cot_politics <- factor(h1data$cot_politics,
                           levels = c("Far Left","Center Left","Center","Center Right","Far Right"))
#why is the above line deleting everything but center

```

## H1 - Violin Plot (with Box Plot)

```{r H1Violin}
#Violin Plot
#Wider sections show where responses are more concentrated within each group.
#The shape depends on smoothing; integer scores can create bumps.
h1viol <- ggplot(data=h1data,
                aes(x=cot_politics, y=viewtotal,
                    fill=cot_politics))+
  geom_violin(width=1)+
  geom_boxplot(width=.05)+
  labs(x="Political Alignment",
       y="Level of Traditional Gender Views",
       title="Progressiveness of Gender Views by Political Alignment")+
  theme_gray(base_size = 10)
h1viol

```


## H2 - Scatter Plots

```{r H2Scatter}
#Scatter Plot
h2points <- ggplot(data=h2data, aes(x=Time_social_media_1, y=Attract_importance_1))+
  geom_jitter(alpha=0.1,color="pink")+
  labs(x="Time spent on social media (minutes/day)", y="Reported Importance of Attractiveness",
       title="Importance Placed on Attractiveness Across Social Media Usage Levels")+
  theme_gray(base_size=12)


```

## H2 - Smooth Line

```{r}
#Scatter Plot with line
h2line <- h2points +geom_smooth(method="lm")
h2line

```

## Save figures

```{r saveFigures}
#Run after creating the plots. Save PNG files in the project's figures folder.
dir.create("figures",showWarnings=FALSE)
ggsave("figures/h1_violin.png",plot=h1viol,width=10,height=6,dpi=300)
ggsave("figures/h2_scatterr.png",plot=h2line,width=10,height=6,dpi=300)
